items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject both candidate product proposals this cycle and authorize no discretionary spend expansion. September AI usage was 5,531 calls costing $1,002.45979265, with 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Revenue evidence is only 2026-09-21 Amazon data: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking_id=other. Site revenue is $0 attributed, but the $4.92 aggregate cannot be assigned to sites; ROI, contribution margin, payback, and causal lift are therefore unsupported. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Keep existing approved work capacity-gated and retain only a report-only finance reconciliation.

Finance gate: do not implement AI cost enforcement or admit new control-plane work while delivery is saturated. Existing AI limits are unset, so no savings forecast or budget headroom is calculable. Preserve usage records and require the report-only finance baseline before defining thresholds. No provider, credential, billing, schedule, or production changes are authorized.

Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable from the brief. Minimum measurement is same-period site-level revenue linked to a registered tracking identifier, plus direct AI, infrastructure, domain, payment, and other attributable delivery costs; for learning, each experiment also needs incremental cost, exposure, treatment/control or pre/post outcome, and a stable change identifier. Do not treat clicks, sessions, impressions, proposal counts, or conversions as profit.
